messages:
Maria Chen: alert from monitor: gpu-pool-usw2-h utilization >= 95% for 5m, admission control engaged. seeing queue length grow and user 429s. dashboard https://dash.redwood.internal/d/gpu-usw2 (perf/alloc view) :eyes:
Aj Patel: confirmed. alert spiked ~10:41 PDT. autoscaler attempted scale but got quota errors. I can share logs in a sec.
Kevin O'Leary: rolling out a heavy batch job from analytics around 10:35 — could be the burst. tagging the team.
Aj Patel: infra-bot log: 
```
[2026-03-18T17:41:05Z] autoscaler: request_scale to +8 nodes -> failed: InsufficientQuota: Requested 8 p4d.12xlarge, available 2
error_code=QuotaExceeded
```
Infra Bot: autoscaler event recorded (id: as-1769005012-7). AdmissionController: soft-throttle enabled, 429 rate limit applied to hosted /v1/generate routes.
SRE OnCall: can we temporarily enlarge the burst pool (gpu-burst-usw2) or move non-prod traffic to another region?
Aj Patel: burst pool at quota too. AWS account quota is the blocker; filing support ticket now. ticket: AWS-34211. ETA unknown.
Maria Chen: we need short mitigations: (1) reduce per-request max_tokens for best-effort customers, (2) enable degraded fallback model (smaller quant) for public tier, (3) route internal batch jobs to us-east-1.
Kevin O'Leary: starting routing change for analytics -> us-east-1 (will run a canary). status: in-progress.
DevEx Sam: can we apply an admission rule to prioritize prod tokens? we already have token-priority but need to tighten. I can push a canary policy.
Aj Patel: pushing admission policy update now: `admission.policy.v2.rate_limits = {"prod": 0.9, "public": 0.1}`. will monitor.
SRE OnCall: watch queue and 429s for next 15m. If tail latency > 2s or 429 rate > 0.5% escalate.
Maria Chen: FYI cost note: we're seeing fallback to on-demand CPU infer for some workloads (higher per-token cost). initial estimate +18% in hourly spend during the burst window.
Kevin O'Leary: analytics can pause the heavy job if needed — holding until routing stable.
Aj Patel: update: support replied, soft quota increase pending but gated by internal approval; might take 3-4 hours.
SRE OnCall: short checklist executed: tightened admission, routed non-prod, paused analytics canary. observing: queue length down from 48 -> 9 in 8m, 429s trending down.
Maria Chen: good. after stabilization, let's schedule a retro: quota planning + proactive shard reservations. also put an alert for autoscaler quota errors specifically (new rule).
Kevin O'Leary: noted. I'll create the retro doc and include cost impact numbers.
DevEx Sam: thanks — I'll update the runbook with the new admission tweak snippet and add a note to DevExp templates for burst jobs. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: closing thread for now — will reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
